value.rationale: Hard-core fugacity zeros on a wheel with a universal hub provide a natural defect-response problem. The result gives an exact all-size real-rootedness boundary and full pair-by-pair collapse diagram, nontrivial exponentially small robustness, and exact square-root opening amplitude for each collision. It is a motivated complete classification, not an arbitrary finite computation or a known-table coefficient recalculation.
